subject: science
title: Ohm's law
instruction: Change the voltage and resistance. Watch the current and the bulb.
intro: Current equals voltage divided by resistance. Try the challenges.

goals.say: Two amperes. For example, 12 volts across 6 ohms.

goals.text: Make the bulb as bright as possible: 12 A.
goals.say: Maximum voltage and minimum resistance give the most current.

goals.text: With 10 V, set the resistance so the current is 1 A.
goals.say: 10 volts divided by 10 ohms is 1 ampere.
